execution_assumption: Decision at completed candle close, next native minute OPEN at least one minute later; real historical bid/ask and depth are unavailable. 0/5/15bps per-side execution haircut scenarios. No invented historical order-book fill.
study_scope: Retrospective comparison of the same frozen twenty methods. Full-day figures precede some recorded model/policy availability clocks; model_available and suite_available views explicitly restrict entries when requested. No full-day untouched/prospective claim.
context_scope: Archived causal news/fundamental evidence only; missing evidence is REJECT under the original model_context contract. Real Codex reviews use original role prompts/schemas; retrospective inference latency is not reproduced.
exit_scope: Original timed expiry remains for horizon methods; barrier methods have no timeout. Open positions are marked net of hypothetical exit fee, never forced sold or counted as wins.
